config.ai_actions_description: Allows the AI to perform real Discord actions on your behalf — such as creating polls — when you ask it to in chat.
config.better_context_description: Gives the AI awareness of the last 5 channel messages and the message being replied to, so it can respond more naturally in ongoing conversations.
config.multimodal_description: Lets Niko understand image attachments and transcribe Discord voice messages when responding. Media is only processed while this experiment is enabled.
config.actions_intro: This experiment lets Niko take real action on your server when you ask in natural language.
config.actions_capabilities:
**What Niko can do**
• Polls — *create a quick poll in chat* (posted directly — no confirmation)
• Moderation — *kick, ban, unban, time-out, remove time-out, warn, purge messages*
• Server management — *create/delete/rename channels, set channel topic, create/delete roles, give or take a role, change a member's nickname*
config.actions_how:
**How it works**
Just talk to Niko (e.g. *“ban this user for spam”* or *“make a channel called announcements”*).
Destructive actions show a confirmation card with the exact action and wait for you to click **Confirm** or **Cancel** — only the person who asked can answer, and the card expires after 45 seconds.
config.actions_permissions:
**Permissions**
Niko will only run an action if **both** you and Niko hold the Discord permission required for it (Kick Members, Ban Members, Moderate Members, Manage Messages, Manage Channels, Manage Roles, Manage Nicknames) — checked in the affected channel, so channel overwrites apply.
The target member or role must also sit below **your** highest role as well as Niko's; the server owner can reach anything below Niko.
config.actions_note: **Note:** This feature is experimental — always double-check the confirmation card before clicking Confirm.
config.context_intro: Gives Niko awareness of recent conversation history so responses feel more natural and connected to what's happening in the channel.
config.context_adds:
**What it adds**
• The last 5 non-bot messages in the channel
• The content of any message being replied to

Niko uses this extra context to understand the flow of conversation before responding.
config.context_note: **Note:** This feature is still under development and may not work as expected.
config.multimodal_body:
When enabled, Niko can inspect up to three image attachments and use the transcription of a Discord voice message as conversation context.

Attachments never start a conversation on their own — they are only used when Niko is already triggered by name, ping, or the ai command.

Images use the configured vision model and voice messages use the configured transcription model. If processing fails, Niko falls back to the text that was sent. Media is not stored by the bot.
config.multimodal_footnote: -# This is experimental and may incur provider usage costs when enabled.

images.edit_removed_body:
AI image editing was retired because the hosted models charged per edit, and we have not found a free provider that produces results we would be happy to ship.

Image **generation** is still free and unlimited-ish — try `{prefix}imagine <prompt>`.

If you know a provider worth trying (a generous free tier or something we could self-host), join the support server and leave a suggestion. We would genuinely like to bring editing back.
